source.title: Most common Ivorian surnames and public name samples

names.notes: Representative Ivorian personal names and common surnames for synthetic form filling. First-name pool should be expanded with a better regional source before marking active.

source.title: Cote d'Ivoire national numbering plan update

phones.notes: ARTCI/ITU communication moved Cote d'Ivoire to 10 national digits from 2021; mobile provider prefixes are 01, 05, and 07.

locations.notes: City and street samples are linked structurally. Postal prefixes remain synthetic placeholders until an official postal/addressing source is added.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: Local Cote d'Ivoire passport format confirmation

passport.notes: Local Cote d'Ivoire operators confirmed real document display format from field samples, including 13AS85673: two digits, two letters, five digits. Registry validity and checksum semantics are not generated.

national_id.label: National ID

source.title: Local Cote d'Ivoire national ID format confirmation

national_id.notes: Local Cote d'Ivoire operators confirmed real document display format from field samples, including CI000910000: CI plus nine digits. Registry validity and checksum semantics are not generated.

driver_license_number.label: Driver License Number

source.title: Local Cote d'Ivoire driver licence format confirmation

driver_license_number.notes: Local Cote d'Ivoire operators confirmed real driver licence display format from field samples: LLLLNN-NN-NNNNNNNNL. Registry validity and checksum semantics are not generated.
